subject: MAP draft + procurement signature deadline — confirm milestones & owners
messages:
From: grace_oconnor
To: Samir Patel <samir@fintegral.com>, Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@procuremax.com>
Cc: ben_carter, marcus_lin
Date: 2027-08-19T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call recap + MAP draft (attached) — next steps and signature runway

Hi Samir / Olivia —

Thanks again for taking the time this morning. Quick recap from my side and a first-pass MAP attached (FIN-341_MAP_v1.xlsx) so we have a single source of truth:

What we discussed
- Primary objective: embed Redwood inference into Fintegral’s fraud workflow (pilot scope: 10M transactions/mo)
- Success metrics: 20% reduction in false positives, <120ms p95 inference latency in production
- Decision criteria: procurement sign-off + legal acceptance of our standard DPA/terms

Draft MAP highlights (attached) 
- Target close: 2027-09-30 (business sign-off)
- Procurement / signature deadline: 2027-09-15 (to meet internal go-live by 10/15)
- Milestones and owners (rows in spreadsheet):
  • PO & pricing approval — owner: Samir (Fintegral procurement) — target 2027-09-01
  • Legal review & redlines — owner: Olivia (Fintegral legal) — target 2027-09-08
  • Internal security checklist & SOC2 evidence — owner: Marcus (Redwood Solutions) — target 2027-09-10
  • Pilot readiness (infra + evals) — owner: Ben (Redwood Services) — target 2027-09-20

Ask for you both:
1) Please review the attached MAP and confirm owners/timelines — particularly legal and procurement dates.
2) If procurement requires an invoice/PO sample earlier than 9/1, flag now so we can prep.
3) Confirm the signature runway — can we lock in 9/15 as the absolute cutover for contract signature?

I’ve also included our terms summary (Redwood_TermsSummary_v1.pdf) for Olivia to review ahead of legal. If it helps, Ben and I can join a short procurement call to walk the PO/invoice path.

Next steps I will take
- Ben will follow up with a short one-pager on billing options (committed vs burst) by EOD tomorrow.
- Marcus will compile SOC2 extract and retention policy docs and upload to the Drive folder.

Thanks — aim to have a 15–20 minute procurement alignment if procurement wants to meet next week.

Regards,
Grace O'Connor
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
grace@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0189

Attachments: FIN-341_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), Redwood_TermsSummary_v1.pdf (PDF)

From: Samir Patel <samir@fintegral.com>
To: grace_oconnor
Cc: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@procuremax.com>, ben_carter, marcus_lin
Date: 2027-08-19T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + MAP draft (attached) — next steps and signature runway

Hi Grace —

Appreciate the concise recap and the MAP draft. A few notes from procurement/legal side:

Procurement / PO timeline
- We typically need a formal PO request 10 business days before signature to coordinate with our AP team — that would put a PO request date around 2027-09-01, so your dates line up.
- For our internal approvals, we need a commercial signoff (finance) by 2027-09-12 to execute on 9/15. If legal drags, that will push things out.

Legal redlines
- Olivia is copying separately but flag: our standard change is around indemnity and data processing clauses. Expect ~3 business days for redlines if there are only small changes; more if we need to loop InfoSec.

Question: will Redwood accept our PO terms that reference a 45-day payment window? We can push for Net30 if Redwood needs it — what's the usual?

I’ll confirm owners internally but I can commit to the 9/15 signature runway if legal and finance stick to the dates. If there’s any slippage on Redwood side (e.g., SOC evidence not available by 9/10), we may need to move the signature out.

Samir
VP, Procurement | Fintegral
samir@fintegral.com | +1 (646) 333-2020

-----Original Message-----
From: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@procuremax.com>
Sent: 2027-08-19T11:00:00-07:00
To: grace_oconnor
Subject: legal will review (short note)

(see below)

From: ben_carter
To: Samir Patel <samir@fintegral.com>, Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@procuremax.com>, grace_oconnor
Cc: marcus_lin
Date: 2027-08-19T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Post-call recap + MAP draft (attached) — next steps and signature runway

Hi all —

Thanks, Samir. Quick clarifications from my side and a slightly updated MAP attached — I moved a couple of internal milestones to reflect Redwood owners and added a short billing appendix. Highlights:

- Billing options: committed monthly cap vs usage with burst; committed gives predictable unit pricing, usage gives flexibility. See billing appendix in FIN-341_MAP_v1.xlsx.
- SOC2 / security evidence: Marcus will push a SOC2 extract + network diagrams to the Drive by 2027-08-22 so Olivia can share with your InfoSec team.
- PO sample: I can send a Redwood PO template (simple line items + billing address) if that helps procurement.

Regarding payment terms — Redwood standard is Net30 but we can review Net45 for strategic pilots with a short finance exception; I’ll loop finance if you prefer Net45.

Request to Fintegral
- Olivia: once legal has redlines, can you send them to legal@redwood.ai and cc me so we can triage quickly?
- Samir: please confirm whether procurement needs a sample invoice or any specific procurement ID to create the PO.

I’m available for a 20-minute procurement/finance sync on 2027-08-24 or 08-26; let me know what works.

Best,
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.ai

Attachments: FIN-341_MAP_v1.xlsx (updated), Redwood_PO_Template.docx (stub)

From: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@procuremax.com>
To: grace_oconnor, ben_carter
Cc: Samir Patel <samir@fintegral.com>, marcus_lin
Date: 2027-08-20T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + MAP draft (attached) — next steps and signature runway

Hi Grace / Ben —

Quick update from legal after an initial skim:
- We reviewed the TermsSummary. Primary redline areas: data processing clauses, liability cap, and standard audit language. We should be able to finish first-pass redlines by EOD 2027-08-24.
- InfoSec wants the SOC2 extract + network diagram; Marcus please share when available (Ben said 8/22).

On timelines — we can aim to keep the 9/15 signature deadline provided:
1) Redwood delivers SOC2 extract by 8/22 (so InfoSec has time to review)
2) We receive the first-pass legal redlines by 8/24
3) Procurement confirms PO creation by 9/01

If those three items land as planned, I’ll push to get legal/finance approvals and keep 9/15 as the signature runway. If any of the three slip more than 3 business days, we’ll need to discuss moving signature to 9/22.

I’ll upload the first-pass redlines to the Drive and ping legal@redwood.ai when it’s ready. If you can share the PO template and sample invoice, that will speed procurement.

Thanks — Olivia
Olivia Chen
Director, Legal Operations | ProcureMax (external legal for Fintegral)
olivia.chen@procuremax.com
